lines.text: Every good story has a beginning, a middle and an end. Code can tell stories too!
“Once upon a time, there was a little fox.”
The fox goes on a trip or finds a problem.
Your blocks follow the story order: beginning blocks first, end blocks last.
Beginning: say “Once upon a time”. Middle: walk to the berry (gem) and pick it. End: say “The end!”.
Beginning, middle, end — a complete story!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
